name: The Twilight Sad
description: Scottish post-punk band The Twilight Sad was scheduled to perform at Hard Club in Porto, but the concert has been cancelled.
longDescription:
Scottish post-punk band The Twilight Sad was scheduled to play Hard Club in Porto on 14 November 2026, with doors originally set to open at 20:00.

The organizers have cancelled the concert due to circumstances beyond their control. Refunds are available from the original point of sale.
descriptionPt: A banda escocesa de post-punk The Twilight Sad tinha concerto marcado no Hard Club, no Porto, mas a data foi cancelada.
longDescriptionPt:
A banda escocesa de post-punk The Twilight Sad tinha concerto marcado no Hard Club, no Porto, a 14 de novembro de 2026, com abertura de portas prevista para as 20h00.

A organização cancelou o espetáculo por motivos de força maior. Os reembolsos podem ser pedidos no ponto de venda onde comprou o bilhete.
